name: Loudoun County, VA
findings: Loudoun County has 1,340 nonprofit organizations. 595 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 468 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Loudoun County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 22 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.
